question: Can I cast Reasonable Doubt just to suspect a creature, when there is no spell on the stack?

expected.shortAnswer: No: there must be a spell on the stack that Reasonable Doubt can legally target.
expected.answer: You can't cast Reasonable Doubt just to suspect a creature. There has to be a spell on the stack that's a legal target for Reasonable Doubt.
